authorised_by: human ruling A (fourth), with the stopping rule: close the class or merge the remainder as named debt. No round 8.
the_change: The guard is INVERTED. It no longer asks 'does this prose match a shape a stale ceiling takes?' — six rounds of that caught each previous crop and missed the next site. It asks 'is this figure allowed to be here at all?' over an enumerated site set (README.md, specs/decisions/*.md including INDEX.md, docs/**/*.md), and allows a hit only if it is the value the workflow declares, inside a ~~struck~~ span, inside ADR-019 section 5 or the workflow (the two allowlisted publishers), or explicitly labelled [historical] (true then) or [local] (not CI's figure). History is MARKED, not exempted.
why_it_fails_safe: A new document, a new phrasing or a new file lands in the scanned set and must justify itself. The previous three patterns failed open: README was invisible for being in the wrong FILE, not the wrong shape.

R32.was: "CI's ceiling is the slowest observed run plus 15% (90s since ADR-019 §5, measured on CI — at the case count of the commit named there, not this one)" — present tense, both halves false: the number, and the qualifier, since run 32937020758 measured 14a6a7b at 213/74, this tree exactly.
R32.now: The false clause is struck in place and labelled [historical]; the live figure is not repeated — section 5 publishes it.

self_exercise: The sweep's asserts call the SAME compiled objects the check runs (_CI_SECONDS, _CI_MOVE, _CI_TOKEN, _CI_LABELLED), which is R34's acceptance criterion applied to the new code as it was written. declared_cost: The [historical]/[local] label is line-scoped while the CI token is window-scoped. A line carrying both a labelled figure and a live one is wholly exempt. Acceptable and stated in the code, because the live values live in the two allowlisted publishers, which the check reads directly.
